config.notes: VU course pages (www.vu.edu.au/courses/<slug>) are stored in the DOMESTIC view (header "Domestic students / Switch to international"): fees are CSP/domestic full fee and Start dates are domestic block dates (e.g. NHCM domestic Feb/Apr/Jul 2027 vs international Feb/Jul 2027), so neither fee nor intakes are read from them. The international view lives at /courses/<slug>/international (fee "AU$x per semester", international start dates) and is not stored. VU Sydney/VU Brisbane pages are international views with a Key information line "CRICOS code : x ... Intakes : 16 February, 27 July ..." but carry their own CRICOS codes (e.g. 093391K, 103277C, 113431D, 093392J, 105070B), not the Melbourne CRICOS of the catalogue course they are bound to; the intakes pattern requires the course's own code so these give nothing. Fees on Sydney/Brisbane pages are "AU$x per semester" (not annual, NOT read). IELTS overall read from "IELTS ... Overall score of x". Extras: Level of study, Duration, Delivery mode, Location, not admitting. Central English: https://www.vu.edu.au/sites/default/files/international-english-language-requirements.pdf (UG 6.0/6.0, PG 6.5/6.0, HE diploma 6.0/5.5, VET 5.5/5.0, named higher courses); key dates: https://www.vu.edu.au/current-students/your-course/timetables-calendars/academic-calendar (VU Block Model; international intakes Semester 1 = February, Semester 2 = July)
